iWant: my voice notes turned into text on my Mac, picked up from my voice-notes folder without my asking, or when I give Squire a recording
soThat: I can work with what I said, and my recordings never leave my Mac
description: A recording the Squire owner puts in the voice-notes folder Squire watches is picked up and transcribed on the Mac without the Squire owner telling Squire, and a recording the Squire owner gives Squire is transcribed the same way. No audio leaves the Mac.
title: Voice notes transcribed on the Mac

acceptanceCriteria.description: Voice notes are transcribed on the Mac and no audio leaves it: a new recording in the Squire owner's voice-notes folder is picked up and transcribed without the Squire owner telling Squire, and a recording given on request is transcribed the same way.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A Squire owner with a voice-notes folder Squire watches, and a recording of their own
acceptanceCriteria.when: The Squire owner puts a new recording in the folder, or gives Squire a recording and asks for it to be transcribed
acceptanceCriteria.then: The recording is transcribed on the Mac and its text kept as a note in the Squire owner's folder, a recording put in the folder without the Squire owner telling Squire; no audio leaves the Mac, and where the Mac cannot transcribe on the Mac itself, nothing is sent and Squire says why.
